baseCurrencies.title: Base currencies
baseCurrencies.description: Currencies to convert FROM, as 3 letter codes (USD, EUR, KES...). One row is produced per base and target pair.

targetCurrencies.title: Target currencies
targetCurrencies.description: Currencies to convert TO. Leave empty to get every available currency (160+ for live rates, 30 majors for history).

dataType.title: What to fetch
dataType.description: Live rates cover 160+ currencies, updated daily. Historical rates come from the European Central Bank: daily values back to 1999 for 30 major currencies.
enumTitles: Historical daily rates (30 majors, back to 1999)

startDate.title: History start date
startDate.description: First date for historical rates, YYYY-MM-DD. Ignored for live rates.

endDate.title: History end date
endDate.description: Last date for historical rates, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty for today. Ignored for live rates.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total (protects your budget on long date ranges).
